items.title: 17-year-old Hacker Responsible for Vegas Casinos Hack has Been Released
items.description: A 17-year-old suspect who surrendered over his alleged role in the 2023 cyberattacks against two major Las Vegas casino operators was released to his parents under strict supervision.
